CITY OF COSTA MESA
  REGULAR CITY COUNCIL AND HOUSING AUTHORITY*
  Agenda

Wednesday, June 25, 2025  11:30 AM  Hilton Costa Mesa
  3050 Bristol Street
  SPECIAL MEETING - STATE OF THE CITY LUNCHEON

The State of the City luncheon is an event held by the Costa Mesa Chamber of Commerce .
Due to an anticipated quorum of the City Council, the event is required to be noticed, the
public may attend without purchasing a ticket and seating will be available (not inclusive of
food, drink, and parking).

The event will be filmed and available on the City website for public viewing.
